name: Last Bit of Sun
source:
A story of just a bit of fun before the sun starts to set.
More specifically, the story of Marielle and her two halves at the end of their world.

Created for the Daydrinking Jam 2026.
translation:
这是一个关于在夕阳西沉之前尽情偷得片刻欢愉的故事。
更确切地说，是玛丽埃尔与她的“两个半身”在世界末日来临之际的故事。

为Daydrinking Jam 2026创作。
